_comment: Platform-wide floor for base images tenants may FROM in Dockerfile/Git/Script modes. Per-tenant extensions live in the tenant_base_image_grants table. Prefixes are matched with startswith; a trailing colon-tag wildcard is implied. Only applies in SaaS mode — on-prem deployments bypass admission.
_mode_comment: When `mode` is 'advisory' (default for SaaS with WIZARD_ALLOW_ANY_IMAGE=true), the prefix list is used only by the Containerizer's prompt to suggest curated bases. Admission accepts any syntactically valid image ref. When 'strict' (or env override WIZARD_ALLOW_ANY_IMAGE=false), the prefix list is a hard gate.

forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.name: curl-piped-to-shell
forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.reason: Piping remote content to a shell bypasses the base-image allowlist and installs arbitrary code at build time.

forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.name: ADD-remote-url
forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.reason: ADD <url> downloads without TLS verification and caches the result in a layer — use COPY after an explicit verified download in a curated base.

forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.name: USER-root-final
forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.reason: Final USER must be non-root. If you need root at build time, drop back to non-root before the last directive.

forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.name: privileged-flag-reference
forbidden_dockerfile_patterns.reason: Privileged-mode references in a Dockerfile imply the node expects elevated runtime — MOD never grants it.
